background: Born and raised in Kingsbridge, the Bronx, in a Black and Ashkenazi Jewish public-sector household; her mother is a city nurse and her father teaches special education.
regionalHistory: One branch came north from Georgia during the Great Migration and another reached the Lower East Side from Romania; both histories are remembered as New York labor stories.
culturalBaseline: Reform and community-minded; Shabbat dinner, synagogue tutoring, and large family reunions all shape her sense of belonging.
sensitivities: Blackness and Jewishness treated as mutually exclusive
being asked to prove her lineage
